newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Coast Guard says VGO tanker aground off Texas.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Coast Guard says VGO tanker aground off Texas.

text.p: The tanker Overseas Valdez, loaded with 274,000 barrels of vacuum gasoil (VGO), ran aground off Galveston Island along the Texas coast, a U.S. Coast Guard spokesman said on Thursday.
Barges were moving into place to lighter the heavy residual fuel from the tanker after a high tide failed to refloat the ship, Coast Guard Petty Officer Rex Harrington said.
"The ship ran aground overnight, and they were hoping the high tide would get it off, but it didn't," he said.
There was no leakage and lightering efforts were expected to begin Thursday evening, Harrington said.
The ship apparently snared a bouy line in its propellers and may have lost power, a local pilot said. "He grabbed bouy five and took it with him," he said of a marker near the mouth of Galveston Bay.
The ship was outbound from a Texas City refinery, but information on its ownership and destination was not immediately available.
